scope: 15 shared canonical entries, all 29 exact r01 age placements and every listed topic row. Original cited pages and complete relevant source units read independently. No other source/tone review outputs read. Corpus-wide review limited to title-only topic lists for the targeted clarity/repetition scan. No shared art.

readLogs.description: Read the complete extracted text of these original PDF pages using a fresh pypdf extraction. This includes the overview, human-tendency context on these pages, the complete Observation unit and its checklist, informal and self-observation, Prepared environment and the practice box. Page 18 starts during an earlier overview paragraph; this is a page-read record, not a claim to have read the complete introduction or chapter.

Read every original-page text in this range: Trust and its deterministic claims, Acceptance, Respect, the complete boundaries, concentration, movement, attachment and crying units, Being their guide, framing, the connection checklist, and the complete Going slow unit. Kept the full crying checklist, no-danger condition, responsive care, safe effort, and warm connection in view. No claim that sensitive setup examples are approved for use.

Read the complete activities introduction, choosing and presenting material, spontaneous exploration, the full further-notes continuation including clothing, and the opening age-guideline paragraph of the appendix directly from original PDF extraction. Also read all text on page 128, which starts the next language unit; not a complete read of that language unit. Read the care, frustration, supervision/material and developmental-concern qualifications as context, without treating them as new app procedures.

Read the actual original text of these pages, including the complete daily-task and budget units, the premature-baby and adoptive-parent context on these pages, the complete Physical disabilities or neurological differences unit, its book recommendation and practice continuation. The entries use daily life and specialist-scope framing only; this log is not a claim to have read the whole chapter.

Read the complete Preparation of the adult chapter body, all 49 personal calm ideas and their introduction, the self-observation box, help for postpartum depression and the separate depressed/burned-out item, self-forgiveness, Doing our best, and final practice questions. Retained the personal-example frame and no-perfection context; frequency/music-healing claims in the source were not imported into the reviewed copy.

Read the full original text from We do not walk alone through the complete daycare-different-values discussion. Includes all village/help lists, partner/grandparent units, the single/co-parent passage and safety exception, complete Getting on the same page discussion and conversation/regular-chat continuations, and the full daycare criteria with availability, cost and warmth qualifications. This is not a whole-book or entire-chapter certification beyond the named span.

Read the complete original text on these pages: relevant principle units, individual development and observation, chapter transition, whole-child activities, complete What makes an activity Montessori and How to show units, and all ten General principles with the small-parts/sharp-object supervision qualification. Read the partial activity, frustration, child-choice and no-purchase context. Page 32 is blank in extraction; no substantive page claim relies on it.

Read the complete original text of the home general-principles sequence: clutter, character/culture, saving work, shared spaces, small spaces and the concluding environment discussion. Included all list continuations and gradual-change framing; did not turn the source furniture examples into requirements.

Read all original text on these pages, including complete Time, safe-base and wonder units on the span; all seven curiosity principles and observation checklist; acceptance, translator and feelings/behavior units. Includes actual working-family and rushed-day exceptions, offering-help language, protective intervention, and tentative interpretation. Page 96 starts with ingredient 2 and page 111 begins a subsequent praise unit, so this is not a claim to have read the whole of chapter 5.

Read the complete Preparation of the adult chapter body from its explicit personal/nonuniversal and anti-perfection introduction through practice questions, plus the next chapter contents page. Read doctor support for depression, routines with children, presence, informal observation, adult interests, slow-down and immediate-danger exception, being a guide, home support, real constraints, apology, self-awareness and continued practice. No whole-book reading claim.

Read the complete Working together chapter body and final practice box, including family forms, adult needs, preferring one parent, the nonconditional planning example, working with others, all caregiver suggestions, the complete active-listening exercise and tips, and both divorce pages with psychological/physical safety exceptions, factual updates and adult-conflict limits.

Inspected readable full-page PNGs rendered directly from the original PDF (page 35 at 100 dpi; 36–37 at 110 dpi). Checked the entire multi-page observation box, category continuation, self-observation and the transition to informal observation/prepared environment. Decorative stacking art did not provide an age or materials basis.

Inspected full original-page renders at 110 dpi. Read the connection checklist, help/frustration passage and boxed further-notes start, and the appendix transition/age-guideline paragraph at readable scale. Page 126 further-notes text continues to page 127, separately fully read in the text log.

Inspected readable full original-page renders at 110 dpi, including the help-seeking paragraph, preparation and self-observation boxes, personal introduction to all 49 ideas, items 1–49 across continuations, and the transition to Doing our best.

Inspected full original-page renders at 110 dpi. Checked the complete single/co-parent safety paragraph, the structured request/conversation list and its continuation boundary, all daycare list content on 254–255 and the complete differing-values discussion. Remaining necessary continuations were read in the original-page full-text log.

Inspected the full two-column observation checklist at readable 120 dpi, including all category headings, social/emotional distinctions and self-observation. Visible printed folio is 97; reviewed public references use PDF page numbering.

Inspected complete original-page renders at 110 dpi: physical self-care/depression help, alternative routines with children and list structure, slow-down continuation and immediate-danger exception, practical constraints and the apology unit. Visible folios are 179, 181, 185 and 189; reviewed public references use PDF page numbering.

Checked family-planning example and its continuation, caregiver list end, complete conflict-exercise continuation/tips, separation safety exception, next-page stability/updates/conflict qualifications and final practice box. Folios 196 and 200–202 are visible; reviewed references use PDF page numbering.

sharedFramingAssessment: The common age navigation is browsing context, the footer reduces home/purchase pressure, and the colophon names original book summaries with references. Shared entries have no opening invitation or illustration. The shared copy avoids source age quotas, deterministic trust outcomes, prescribed adult routines and synthetic sensitive-care procedures. Necessary short-surface qualifications remain visible. Targeted title changes and two public reference-locator edits are recorded per affected placement; unflagged warm phrasing is intentionally retained.

titleOnlyCorpusScan.scope: All ten age/topic title lists in the r01 manifest; only titles and placement topic metadata read outside this shared batch. No other-entry prose or source/tone reviews read.
titleOnlyCorpusScan.assessment: Repeated room/space/part constructions reduce distinction in the long lists, but are not inherently defects. The shared feelings-and-limit and another-try titles still name a recognizable purpose. Corrections target missing activity/participation/support/enjoyment subjects and the repeated room phrasing within the busy-day entry; they do not require uniform technical headings or a blanket rewrite.

textPlacement.assessment: The title names a simple action; the summary, cue and details offer factual noticing, optional notes, adult self-observation and available help without a diagnosis, test, schedule or silent-observer ideal. The 6–9-month placement applies this shared adult/relationship perspective without a baby milestone or an imported toddler action.
